caption: The drawing depicts a woven horse cinch, oriented vertically on a plain, light-colored background. The cinch has two large, circular metallic rings at each end. Surrounding the rings are triangular sections of brown leather, decorated with floral or ornate tooling patterns. The main body of the cinch consists of tightly woven fibers in shades of gray, beige, and white, arranged in vertical stripes. In the center, a small horizontal metallic ring is attached to the weave, with a short, grayish tassel hanging from it. The composition is symmetrical, with the elements mirrored about the horizontal center axis, and the object is rendered with fine detail to show texture, stitching, and material differences.
title: Cinch for Saddle
